en: A black and white image showing a grand baroque palace complex with manicured gardens and ornate sculptures. The central courtyard is framed by architectural structures with elaborate facades, domes, and arched windows. In the background, two tall cathedral spires and additional ornate towers are visible. The garden features formal paths, trimmed hedges, and a monument or statue at its center. Subtle text is seen on the upper right building: 'SALON'.
